bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up {name}
bluetooth_confirm.description:
Found AirVersa diffuser **{ble_name}**.

Enter its 4-digit activation code. The factory default is **8888**. If you changed it in the Sleekpoint app, use your code.

Close the Sleekpoint app first: the diffuser only accepts one Bluetooth connection at a time. It will beep once while the code is checked.

user.title: Set up an AirVersa diffuser
user.description:
Pick a diffuser Home Assistant can see over Bluetooth, and enter its 4-digit activation code (factory default **8888**).

Close the Sleekpoint app first: the diffuser only accepts one Bluetooth connection at a time.

reauth_confirm.title: New activation code for {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The diffuser rejected the saved activation code. This usually means it was changed in the Sleekpoint app. Enter the current 4-digit code.

error.invalid_key: The diffuser rejected that activation code.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't connect. Make sure the diffuser is powered on, in range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy, and not connected to the Sleekpoint app.

abort.already_configured: This diffuser is already set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No AirVersa diffusers found over Bluetooth. Make sure the diffuser is powered on, in range of a Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome Bluetooth proxy, and not connected to the Sleekpoint app.
